complete_examples.text: In China, coal resources have a reverse distribution between produc-tion and consumption, driving the rapid development of heavy haul railway technology.
Therefore, understanding and controlling basement construction deficiencies are of great significance for the long-term stability of heavy haul railway tunnels.
